title: Verify printing responsibility boundaries
description: Audit the printing-setup workflow and tests so it exposes records and operator confirmations only, with no printer discovery, silent printing, dialog control, or physical-print confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: No application control or copy claims to discover/select a printer, inspect/change dialog values, load media, trigger silent printing, or confirm physical printing
Setup, revision, attestation, and reconfirmation flows remain keyboard operable and survive reload
Focused tests assert explicit unknowns, immutable revisions, contradiction refusal, exact attestation references, and fresh reconfirmation
All user-visible disclosures distinguish recorded assumptions from browser-verified facts

steps.details: Search setup and preparation UI/domain paths for prohibited controls or claims and replace any inference with explicit operator-owned wording.
Add focused tests that fail if prohibited discovery, silent-print, dialog-control, or physical-confirmation language/actions appear.
Run a keyboard browser path through mixed unknown setup creation, both revision types, refinement/contradiction, attestation, reconfirmation, and reload.
Run focused unit/browser tests plus relevant build and lint checks, recording any physical prerequisite as intentionally unnecessary for software validation.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; run focused boundary assertions rather than the full release suite.
No printer or synthetic physical result is needed or permitted to close this software-only task.
Recorded is not verified, and preparation is not printing.
